keyword: how to file an extension for taxes
claims: Submitting Form 4868 by April 15 grants an automatic six-month extension until October 15.
A federal tax extension does not extend time to pay taxes owed.
The IRS Free File system allows e-filing Form 4868 regardless of income.
Most tax software providers offer e-filing of Form 4868.
Selecting "Extension" as the payment type when making a payment via IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or digital wallet automatically files Form 4868.
Form 4868 can be completed and mailed by April 15.
The IRS advises ensuring a timely postmark when mailing Form 4868.
A tax extension request must be submitted by 11:59 p.m. local time on April 15, 2026.
An extension to file is not an extension to pay.
Taxes owed must be estimated and paid by April 15 to avoid penalties and interest.
Taxpayers expecting a refund do not have to file an extension.
